### Do you consider these 7 factors in the patient mobility assessment process?

The International Standards for manual handling of people in the healthcare sector discuss various
methods of assessment¹. The most essential transfers take place multiple times throughout the daily
journey.

[Read article][148]
[Flowtron ACS900 (10)]

### VTE Prevention

 

Venous thromboembolism (VTE) is a serious condition that causes death and disability worldwide, with
10 million cases each year. In order to safeguard the well-being of at-risk patients, comprehensive
prevention strategies that take into account individual clinical needs are essential.

 


[Learn more ][149]
[Natasa and Irma outside Benevit facility (23)]

### ''Movement provides a better quality of life for our residents''

For Benevit’s nursing homes, long-term sick leave time has dropped massively, partly due to
ergonomics training and use of aids. One key differentiator: the integration of the Arjo MOVE
program, which has shown positive impacts on physical and mental stress within the nursing teams,
and a better quality of life for residents.

[See their story here][150]
[Hygiene Relaxing (2)]

### Hygiene and Wellness

Hygiene is an essential part of well-being. Arjo integrated Hygiene and Wellness Solutions enable
you to deliver a tailored and therapeutic experience for dependent residents and patients, helping
you improve wellbeing and efficiency in your care environment.

[Explore ][151]
[MyArjo image 1]

### Introducing MyArjo: Your portal to Arjo tools and services

MyArjo is a personalised web portal providing access to Arjo tools and services with one secure
login.

Sign up to get MyArjo access and begin your journey to Empower Movement today.

[Discover MyArjo][152]
[Academy banner 1920x450px final2.jpg]

## [ Arjo Academy: Your path to professional development ][153]

Access a comprehensive range of accredited and non-accredited live and

on-demand webinars, courses and E-Learnings.

 

 

START YOUR LEARNING JOURNEY
[Arjo blue studio background]

## Our Product Categories

##### [Patient Handling][154]

For patients and residents with limited or impaired mobility, time spent out of bed may be a
specific rehabilitation goal or the highlight of their day.

##### [Medical beds][155]

We offer a wide range of hospital and long term healthcare beds that allow good infection control,
offer enhanced ergonomics, comfort, safety and ease of use, and promote effective risk management.

##### [Hygiene][156]

Our hygiene solutions are designed to facilitate efficient and secure hygiene care and wellness
routines while helping to reduce workload for caregivers.

##### [Pressure Injury Prevention][157]

Arjo empowers you with the ability to elevate the pressure injury prevention pathway in your care
environment, equipping you with the knowledge, skills and tools to act on a new standard of clinical
excellence and deliver measurable outcomes in early identification, prevention and management of
pressure injuries..

##### [Disinfection][158]

Flusher disinfectors and flusher liquids to support your infection control strategy.

##### [VTE prevention][159]

While healthcare facilities are aware of the risk of VTE, care providers do not always have the
time, training or resources to implement optimal prevention strategies. With the Arjo Flowtron
Active Compression System, professional caregivers can deliver safe, convenient and flexible VTE
prevention therapy that helps them achieve compliance and optimal clinical efficacy.

[Positive 8 ]

### The Positive Eight Philosophy

Our care philosophy explains how facilitating mobility can catalyse a chain of benefits impacting
quality of life, caregiver satisfaction, operational efficiency, and financial outcomes. 

[read more ][160]
[Mobility gallery Long Term Care Group]

### Mobility gallery

Based on 5 levels of mobility from A to E, the Arjo Mobility Gallery provides a basis for
understanding how an individual can contribute to their mobility, as well as how to safeguard
caregivers from injuries.

[read more][161]
[Sara Flex with Sara 3000 Standing Sling (5)]

### Arjo MOVE

Rooted in clinical evidence and driven by your facility data, Arjo MOVE programs arm you with the
tools and knowledge to reach your clinical and operational goals.

[read more ][162]
[Banner What moves you Jonathan Nouel 1600x600 01]

### Do you consider these 7 factors in the patient mobility assessment process?

The International Standards for manual handling of people in the healthcare sector discuss various
methods of assessment¹. The most essential transfers take place multiple times throughout the daily
journey.

[Read article][148]
[Flowtron ACS900 (10)]

### VTE Prevention

 

Venous thromboembolism (VTE) is a serious condition that causes death and disability worldwide, with
10 million cases each year. In order to safeguard the well-being of at-risk patients, comprehensive
prevention strategies that take into account individual clinical needs are essential.

 


[Learn more ][149]
[Natasa and Irma outside Benevit facility (23)]

### ''Movement provides a better quality of life for our residents''

For Benevit’s nursing homes, long-term sick leave time has dropped massively, partly due to
ergonomics training and use of aids. One key differentiator: the integration of the Arjo MOVE
program, which has shown positive impacts on physical and mental stress within the nursing teams,
and a better quality of life for residents.

[See their story here][150]
[Hygiene Relaxing (2)]

### Hygiene and Wellness

Hygiene is an essential part of well-being. Arjo integrated Hygiene and Wellness Solutions enable
you to deliver a tailored and therapeutic experience for dependent residents and patients, helping
you improve wellbeing and efficiency in your care environment.

[Explore ][151]
[MyArjo image 1]

### Introducing MyArjo: Your portal to Arjo tools and services

MyArjo is a personalised web portal providing access to Arjo tools and services with one secure
login.

Sign up to get MyArjo access and begin your journey to Empower Movement today.

[Discover MyArjo][152]
[Academy banner 1920x450px final2.jpg]

## [ Arjo Academy: Your path to professional development ][153]

Access a comprehensive range of accredited and non-accredited live and

on-demand webinars, courses and E-Learnings.

 

 

START YOUR LEARNING JOURNEY
[Arjo blue studio background]

## Our Product Categories

##### [Patient Handling][154]

For patients and residents with limited or impaired mobility, time spent out of bed may be a
specific rehabilitation goal or the highlight of their day.

##### [Medical beds][155]

We offer a wide range of hospital and long term healthcare beds that allow good infection control,
offer enhanced ergonomics, comfort, safety and ease of use, and promote effective risk management.

##### [Hygiene][156]

Our hygiene solutions are designed to facilitate efficient and secure hygiene care and wellness
routines while helping to reduce workload for caregivers.

##### [Pressure Injury Prevention][157]

Arjo empowers you with the ability to elevate the pressure injury prevention pathway in your care
environment, equipping you with the knowledge, skills and tools to act on a new standard of clinical
excellence and deliver measurable outcomes in early identification, prevention and management of
pressure injuries..

##### [Disinfection][158]

Flusher disinfectors and flusher liquids to support your infection control strategy.

##### [VTE prevention][159]

While healthcare facilities are aware of the risk of VTE, care providers do not always have the
time, training or resources to implement optimal prevention strategies. With the Arjo Flowtron
Active Compression System, professional caregivers can deliver safe, convenient and flexible VTE
prevention therapy that helps them achieve compliance and optimal clinical efficacy.

### The Positive Eight Philosophy

Our care philosophy explains how facilitating mobility can catalyse a chain of benefits impacting
quality of life, caregiver satisfaction, operational efficiency, and financial outcomes.

Based on 5 levels of mobility from A to E, the Arjo Mobility Gallery provides a basis for
understanding how an individual can contribute to their mobility, as well as how to safeguard
caregivers from injuries.

Rooted in clinical evidence and driven by your facility data, Arjo MOVE programs arm you with the
tools and knowledge to reach your clinical and operational goals.

## About AN Adamant Noyau

##### About Us

At AN Adamant Noyau, our mission is to deliver deeply restorative sleep built upon a core of
uncompromising quality and innovation. We understand that a great mattress is the foundation of
well-being, which is why we’ve poured countless hours into meticulously developing and refining our
hybrid designs. Our process focuses on engineering the perfect synergy between supportive individual
pocket springs and pressure-relieving CertiPUR-US certified memory foam. This dedication ensures
every mattress provides the optimal medium-firmness, targeted zonal support for spinal alignment,
and superior motion isolation that allows you to sleep uncompromised.

Beyond the physical product, we have invested significant time and resources into developing a
seamless customer experience, notably by improving our official website. For example, we’ve
implemented an interactive “Find Your Firmness” quiz to guide you instantly to the best product for
your sleep style, and we’ve dramatically streamlined the checkout process to be completed in fewer
than three clicks. Our commitment extends to making complex technical information easily accessible,
ensuring clear and transparent product pages that detail every feature, from our enhanced edge
support to our highly breathable fabrics, so you can feel completely confident in your purchase from
the moment you land on our site.

##### Our History

AN Adamant Noyau was founded with a singular purpose: to challenge the status quo of mattress
shopping by delivering premium, hybrid sleep technology directly to your door. From our initial
development, we focused on fusing the lasting support of traditional spring systems with the
contouring comfort of modern memory foam, a philosophy embodied in our name, which signifies an
“unyielding core.” Our history is one of continuous refinement, driven by a commitment to sourcing
high-quality, certified materials and optimizing our boxed delivery model, ensuring that every
customer receives a durable, comfortable, and deeply supportive mattress without the typical retail
hassle or inflated price.

## Stay Connected with AN Adamant Noyau

Join our community to receive exclusive offers, new product announcements, and expert tips for
better sleep.

## About AN Adamant Noyau

##### About Us

At AN Adamant Noyau, our mission is to deliver deeply restorative sleep built upon a core of
uncompromising quality and innovation. We understand that a great mattress is the foundation of
well-being, which is why we’ve poured countless hours into meticulously developing and refining our
hybrid designs. Our process focuses on engineering the perfect synergy between supportive individual
pocket springs and pressure-relieving CertiPUR-US certified memory foam. This dedication ensures
every mattress provides the optimal medium-firmness, targeted zonal support for spinal alignment,
and superior motion isolation that allows you to sleep uncompromised.

Beyond the physical product, we have invested significant time and resources into developing a
seamless customer experience, notably by improving our official website. For example, we’ve
implemented an interactive “Find Your Firmness” quiz to guide you instantly to the best product for
your sleep style, and we’ve dramatically streamlined the checkout process to be completed in fewer
than three clicks. Our commitment extends to making complex technical information easily accessible,
ensuring clear and transparent product pages that detail every feature, from our enhanced edge
support to our highly breathable fabrics, so you can feel completely confident in your purchase from
the moment you land on our site.

##### Our History

AN Adamant Noyau was founded with a singular purpose: to challenge the status quo of mattress
shopping by delivering premium, hybrid sleep technology directly to your door. From our initial
development, we focused on fusing the lasting support of traditional spring systems with the
contouring comfort of modern memory foam, a philosophy embodied in our name, which signifies an
“unyielding core.” Our history is one of continuous refinement, driven by a commitment to sourcing
high-quality, certified materials and optimizing our boxed delivery model, ensuring that every
customer receives a durable, comfortable, and deeply supportive mattress without the typical retail
hassle or inflated price.

### **PIM Beratung**

**Zur Einführung eines PIM Systems zählt es nicht nur das richtige System** **auszuwählen**, sondern
eine klare Zieldefinition hierfür festzulegen und auch Prozesse und Organisation mit zu
berücksichtigen.

Wir unterstützen Sie dabei Ihr PIM-Projekt ganzheitlich zu betrachten und die Grundlage für die
erfolgreiche Einführung Ihres PIM-Systems zu legen.

Zudem bieten wir Ihnen interessante [**White Paper**][69] zum Thema PIM, die Ihren Wissensschatz
erweitern und als wertvolle Entscheidungshilfe dienen können.

[PIM Implementeierung]

### **PIM Implementierung**

**Wir beraten nicht nur, wir setzen auch um.**
Hierbei gehen wir nach der agilen Umsetzungsmethode vor. Diese bietet die Möglichkeit, schnell
Resultate zu erzielen und damit zeitnah Business-Value zu generieren.

Dies ermöglicht außerdem schnelle Anpassungen an sich ändernde Anforderungen, so wie wir diese heute
in digitalen Projekten immer wieder sehen.

Unsere [**Success Stories**][71] mit namenhaften Kunden bieten Ihnen einen praxisnahen Einblick in
unsere Arbeit.

[ MEHR ][72]
[BYRD – theplatform – Badge]

### **BYRD**

**Für Product Content Management und Syndication**

[**BYRD**][73] ist die intelligente Product Content Life Cycle Management-Plattform mit
branchenspezifischen Lösungspaketen, die ohne Anpassungs- oder Implementierungsaufwand sofort
eingesetzt werden können.

**BYRD** enthält nicht nur maßgeschneiderte Module für das Product Information Management (PIM),
Product Content Syndication, Product Content Aggregation und KI-basierte Produktklassifizierung,
sondern auch den etablierten GS1-zertifizierten GDSN-Datenpool b-synced.

# The New Beds.org Experience

Beds.org is the first organization devoted to solely setting standards for the beds you sleep on.
Our mission is to provide an unbiased, objective, informational website that will educate the public
about **beds** and **mattresses**, including the importance of a mattress, the components of a bed,
how to judge the quality of a mattress, and how to find the bed or bedding that is right for you.
With the change over in ownership and management, we now focus on bringing you [mattress
reviews][55] with real mattress ratings from unbiased customers like yourself. With features like
our **free members only bed discount buying club, expert reviews and customizable comparison
charts** of products you choose to evaluate, as a shopper, you really have the tools at your
disposal to make the best choice with your mattress and bed purchasing needs. Our reviews and
ratings include mattress reviews from a wide variety of brands, such as Sealy, Simmons, Serta,
Spring Air, Tempur-pedic, Select Comfort and much more! We also made sure we chose many different
models that incorporate in these mattress reviews all types of sleeping surfaces such as memory
foam, latex mattresses, spring mattresses, airbeds, and waterbeds.

## Bed and Mattress Shopping Made Easy!

Our industry experts have been assembled to provide a clear and concise way of evaluating the
current beds on the market, so the consumer can make an educated choice when
purchasing the best mattress, bed-set, or bedding accessories for their situation.  We have no
affiliation particular brand, so you get them all in one place!  When you combine this with our
discount buyers club and personal beds and mattresses concierge service (a new personal service that
guarantees you the best price on any mattress or bed you choose), as well as our customizable bed
and mattress comparison chart, you will have all the tools you need to make the smartest mattress or
bed shopping decision.

## The First Truly Customizable
## Bed and Mattress Comparison Chart!

With our **Bed** and** Mattress Reviews** and Comparisons pages, you will get a full review of each
particular model, including the actual components, warranty and sleep trial offered.  You can then
add them to our proprietary customizable Bed and Mattress Comparison Chart, where you can put all
the mattresses and beds side by side and evaluate each on the features they have to offer.  If you
sign-up as a member, you can make notes that will be stored with each mattress review on our
customizable mattress and bed comparison table, so you can always come back to this chart and
re-evaluate what you read and your thoughts at the time, months or even years later!

# The decubitus specialist of Europe

## Bos medical international – anti decubitus products

Bos Medical Int. is a trusted and experienced partner in the field of pressure ulcer prevention,
specializing in the import and distribution of high-quality medical products. We offer a
comprehensive range of solutions, including mattresses, gel positioners, wheelchair cushions, and
positioning aids, designed to support both the prevention and treatment of bedsores.

Our focus is on delivering durable and comfortable products that ensure reliable protection and
optimal support for patients. With a commitment to quality, comfort, and patient well-being, Bos
Medical Int. provides solutions that healthcare professionals and caregivers can depend on.

## Lying position

Prolonged exposure to a lying position significantly increases the risk of developing bedsores. In
such cases, it is crucial to properly relieve the patient’s pressure, which can be provided by a
specialized mattress or other anti-decubitus products. Such solutions effectively prevent the
formation of new wounds and promote the healing process of existing ones. As an importer of medical
products, Bos Medical Int. offers a wide range of high-quality products dedicated to patients
requiring long-term lying, providing them with protection and comfort at the highest level.

## Sitting position

Wheelchair users are at particular risk of developing pressure sores due to prolonged sitting and
limited mobility. In such cases, specialized decubitus cushions play a key role by providing
adequate support and pressure relief at critical pressure points. Bos Medical Int., as a reputable
importer of medical products, offers a wide range of anti decubitus cushions designed for wheelchair
users. Our products help reduce the risk of wounds by adapting to patients’ individual needs and
guaranteeing optimal comfort and safety during daily wheelchair use.

## Positioning

At Bos Medical Int. we offer innovative pressure ulcer prevention products that promote proper
patient positioning. Staying in one position for long periods of time, whether sitting or lying
down, puts excessive pressure on certain points on the body, which increases the risk of developing
bedsores. This risk is also present for surgical patients who stay in one position – on their back,
side or abdomen – for many hours. The risk of developing bedsores increases significantly over time,
so it is crucial to provide patients with maximum comfort, safety and stability. We will be glad to
advise and help you choose the right solutions.

## About Bos Medical International

Bos Medical Int. has specialized in pressure ulcer prevention products for more than 30 years. Our
business is based on long-term partnerships with customers, which has allowed us to build a solid
international customer base. We always strive to find the best solution, taking into account both
the needs of patients and applicable regulations. We base our business on long-term partnerships
with customers, which has allowed us to build a solid international customer base. As a company, we
focus on innovation and are constantly raising standards to meet the expectations of the medical
market.

[Read more][91]
 
[Private-Label-Mattress-Stratus-Bos-Medical-International]
 

## Private label?

At Bos Medical International, we offer the possibility to produce and supply private label
anti-decubitus products. This means the products can be customized to carry your own brand label,
including your logo, slogan, or other branding elements.

Our private label service is ideal for partners looking to offer high-quality pressure ulcer
prevention products under their own brand, with the assurance of Bos Medical Int.’s expertise and
reliability.

[Read more][92]
 
 

## Our service

[bos-medical-international-knowledge]

##### Knowledge

For 30 years we have been providing our customers with products and knowledge to prevent and treat
pressure ulcers.

##### Quality

We give a lot of attention to the quality of our products. They have a long lifespan.

##### quick delivery

Because there is an in-house stock, our products can be delivered immediately.

##### dropshipping

We can also supply customers by dropshipping.

##### private label

We offer the possibility to print products with a company logo and/or slogan.

##### custom made

You want a specific color or material? In consultation, we will make the product completely
according to your wishes.

##### product specialist

Within the topic of decubitus, we are aware of all product developments, laws and regulations.

##### training and demonstrations

We offer training and demonstrations to explain the use of our products and share our expertise with
customers and end users.

# The decubitus specialist of Europe

## Bos medical international – anti decubitus products

Bos Medical Int. is a trusted and experienced partner in the field of pressure ulcer prevention,
specializing in the import and distribution of high-quality medical products. We offer a
comprehensive range of solutions, including mattresses, gel positioners, wheelchair cushions, and
positioning aids, designed to support both the prevention and treatment of bedsores.

Our focus is on delivering durable and comfortable products that ensure reliable protection and
optimal support for patients. With a commitment to quality, comfort, and patient well-being, Bos
Medical Int. provides solutions that healthcare professionals and caregivers can depend on.

## Lying position

Prolonged exposure to a lying position significantly increases the risk of developing bedsores. In
such cases, it is crucial to properly relieve the patient’s pressure, which can be provided by a
specialized mattress or other anti-decubitus products. Such solutions effectively prevent the
formation of new wounds and promote the healing process of existing ones. As an importer of medical
products, Bos Medical Int. offers a wide range of high-quality products dedicated to patients
requiring long-term lying, providing them with protection and comfort at the highest level.

## Sitting position

Wheelchair users are at particular risk of developing pressure sores due to prolonged sitting and
limited mobility. In such cases, specialized decubitus cushions play a key role by providing
adequate support and pressure relief at critical pressure points. Bos Medical Int., as a reputable
importer of medical products, offers a wide range of anti decubitus cushions designed for wheelchair
users. Our products help reduce the risk of wounds by adapting to patients’ individual needs and
guaranteeing optimal comfort and safety during daily wheelchair use.

## Positioning

At Bos Medical Int. we offer innovative pressure ulcer prevention products that promote proper
patient positioning. Staying in one position for long periods of time, whether sitting or lying
down, puts excessive pressure on certain points on the body, which increases the risk of developing
bedsores. This risk is also present for surgical patients who stay in one position – on their back,
side or abdomen – for many hours. The risk of developing bedsores increases significantly over time,
so it is crucial to provide patients with maximum comfort, safety and stability. We will be glad to
advise and help you choose the right solutions.

## Private label?

At Bos Medical International, we offer the possibility to produce and supply private label
anti-decubitus products. This means the products can be customized to carry your own brand label,
including your logo, slogan, or other branding elements.

Our private label service is ideal for partners looking to offer high-quality pressure ulcer
prevention products under their own brand, with the assurance of Bos Medical Int.’s expertise and
reliability.

For 30 years we have been providing our customers with products and knowledge to prevent and treat
pressure ulcers.

##### Quality

We give a lot of attention to the quality of our products. They have a long lifespan.

##### quick delivery

Because there is an in-house stock, our products can be delivered immediately.

##### dropshipping

We can also supply customers by dropshipping.

##### private label

We offer the possibility to print products with a company logo and/or slogan.

##### custom made

You want a specific color or material? In consultation, we will make the product completely
according to your wishes.

##### product specialist

Within the topic of decubitus, we are aware of all product developments, laws and regulations.

##### training and demonstrations

We offer training and demonstrations to explain the use of our products and share our expertise with

## development and production of anti-decubitus mattress

#### decu® series anti-decubitus mattress
####  

Innovative anti-decubitus mattresses designed to provide optimal care for patients at risk of
developing pressure ulcers. Our air mattresses offer automatic pressure settings according to
patient weight, a cell ventilation system that reduces heat and moisture, and detachable cells that
reduce pressure in high-risk areas. Our hybrid mattresses combine foam and air and are specially
designed to distribute weight over a larger area, reducing pressure on the skin and preventing
ulcers up to stage IV. Thank you for considering our advanced mattresses for the prevention and
treatment of pressure ulcers. All typec of our mattress are made in Czech Republic.

## decu® hybrid series

#### Innovative technology

Mattresses combining foam and air for the maximum prevention and therapy support of ulcers/decubitus
up to and including stage IV: very high risk. The decu hybrid line combines a static stage II and
dynamic stage IV solution in one. The flattened shape of the cell structure in the hybrid systems
allows for the weight to be distributed over a larger area, thus reducing the pressure on the skin. 

#### 2 in 1

The hybrid design allows for continual static prevention and treatment of pressure ulcers without a
power source, e.g., during transport.

#### Low high

With a maximum height of just 12cm, the function of side rails remains intact, thus eliminating the
risk of the patient falling out of bed. Acute cases may start initial treatment without inflation.
The CPR valve enables acute resuscitation and use without inflation means you do not have to
manipulate a patient until after the mattress is inflated.

[DOWNLOAD CATALOG HERE][7]

## decu® air series

#### Classic conception

A range of air mattresses from decubitus stage II to IV / low to very high risk. The traditional air
conception mattress is widely used all over the world in home, social and hospital care.

#### Good price

The advantage of this conception is the favorable purchase price.

## Hospital Mattress - NHS Grade Waterproof Mattresses

All our Hospital Grade Waterproof Mattresses adhere to care specifications outlined by the NHS.
These hospital mattresses are designed to provide pressure relief to those at a moderate to high
risk of developing pressure ulcers (bed sores). They are fitted with an easy to clean, waterproof
cover which helps to protect from damage caused by incontinence.

## Pressure-Relieving Mattress

By implementing advanced foam cutting techniques into our mattresses, we can create a product which
provides ultimate levels of comfort while substantially reducing pressure on the body. Pressure
ulcers are a common complaint amongst patients subjected to extended periods of bed rest. Our
pressure-relieving mattresses help to reduce the risks associated with bed sores.

## Medical Mattress - Nautilus Water Resistant Mattresses

Nautilus Contract Fabric is leading material designed to provide ultimate levels of comfort whilst
maintaining an unparalleled resistance to liquid. For sufferers of incontinence, our Nautilus
mattresses are ideal. These waterproof mattresses are often used in care homes to help maintain
sanitary conditions, while providing relief to both patients and staff.

## Mattress Protectors and Covers

Our mattress protectors and covers offer a variety of benefits. Our climate controlling Coolmax
covers help to regulate body temperature, while our nautilus mattress protectors are highly water
resistant. Whether you require a replacement or need to protect your existing mattress, our mattress
protectors and covers can help.

### Hospital Mattress Services

GB Foam was established in 1976 as an independent converter of polyurethane foam. The company
currently employs over 30 staff and operates from two sites in Buckinghamshire.

For over 40 years we have been providing a comprehensive range of specialist foam products to the
Healthcare sector, specialising in the likes of hospital mattresses, waterproof mattresses, and
pressure relief mattresses.

We provide pressure relief mattresses to UK hospitals and our water-resistant mattresses can be
found in nursing homes up and down the country. All our products are made to the very highest
specifications. We adhere only to the ISO 9001 criteria and use the finest materials within all our
medical mattresses.

We’ve supplied to some of the most notable names in UK healthcare including the NHS and BUPA. Now,
we’re making our full range of mattresses available for all. Whether you need a single
water-resistant mattress or multiple NHS specification mattresses, you’ll find everything you need
here at GB Foam Healthcare.

### Affordable Medical Mattress Range for All

Originally, we would only supply our medical mattresses to large healthcare companies. It was then
the responsibility of healthcare professionals to make them available to the retail market. We
realised that this practice resulted in an inflated price of our medical mattres

## Hospital Mattress - NHS Grade Waterproof Mattresses

All our Hospital Grade Waterproof Mattresses adhere to care specifications outlined by the NHS.
These hospital mattresses are designed to provide pressure relief to those at a moderate to high
risk of developing pressure ulcers (bed sores). They are fitted with an easy to clean, waterproof
cover which helps to protect from damage caused by incontinence.

## Pressure-Relieving Mattress

By implementing advanced foam cutting techniques into our mattresses, we can create a product which
provides ultimate levels of comfort while substantially reducing pressure on the body. Pressure
ulcers are a common complaint amongst patients subjected to extended periods of bed rest. Our
pressure-relieving mattresses help to reduce the risks associated with bed sores.

## Medical Mattress - Nautilus Water Resistant Mattresses

Nautilus Contract Fabric is leading material designed to provide ultimate levels of comfort whilst
maintaining an unparalleled resistance to liquid. For sufferers of incontinence, our Nautilus
mattresses are ideal. These waterproof mattresses are often used in care homes to help maintain
sanitary conditions, while providing relief to both patients and staff.

## Mattress Protectors and Covers

Our mattress protectors and covers offer a variety of benefits. Our climate controlling Coolmax
covers help to regulate body temperature, while our nautilus mattress protectors are highly water
resistant. Whether you require a replacement or need to protect your existing mattress, our mattress
protectors and covers can help.

### Hospital Mattress Services

GB Foam was established in 1976 as an independent converter of polyurethane foam. The company
currently employs over 30 staff and operates from two sites in Buckinghamshire.

For over 40 years we have been providing a comprehensive range of specialist foam products to the
Healthcare sector, specialising in the likes of hospital mattresses, waterproof mattresses, and
pressure relief mattresses.

We provide pressure relief mattresses to UK hospitals and our water-resistant mattresses can be
found in nursing homes up and down the country. All our products are made to the very highest
specifications. We adhere only to the ISO 9001 criteria and use the finest materials within all our
medical mattresses.

We’ve supplied to some of the most notable names in UK healthcare including the NHS and BUPA. Now,
we’re making our full range of mattresses available for all. Whether you need a single
water-resistant mattress or multiple NHS specification mattresses, you’ll find everything you need
here at GB Foam Healthcare.

realised that this practice resulted in an inflated price of our medical mattres

Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

# Venta y alquiler de camas articuladas y enfermería a domicilio en Málaga

Nuestra experiencia en el sector y nuestro enfoque asistencial nos permiten dar respuesta inmediata
a situaciones de dependencia, cuidados domiciliarios en casa o recuperación postoperatoria.
[ Ver productos ][27]
[ Llámanos ahora ][28]
Nuestros Servicios

## Venta y alquiler de productos ortopédicos con entrega
## rápida y profesional

El alquiler y venta de equipos para personas dependientes representa la solución más flexible y
eficiente para pacientes y familias que necesitan equipamiento

## Venta y alquiler de camas articuladas

Camas hospitalarias eléctricas de última generación con control remoto, barandillas de seguridad y
colchones clínicos adaptados a cada necesidad.

[Ver camas articuladas ➔][29]

## Venta y alquiler de sillas de ruedas y grúas ortopédicas

Sillas de ruedas eléctricas y manuales, grúas de transferencia y bipedestación para facilitar la
movilidad y el cuidado del paciente.

[Ver sillas y grúas ➔][30]

## Venta y alquiler de equipos de oxigenoterapia

Concentradores de oxígeno, CPAP para apnea del sueño y equipos de oxigenoterapia domiciliaria con
servicio técnico especializado.

[Ver equipos de oxigenoterapia ➔][31]

**Nuestro valor diferencial** es la rapidez de servicio, coordinación directa con personal sanitario
y asesoramiento personalizado, lo que nos permite realizar entregas urgentes, asegurar una correcta
instalación de equipamiento y un servicio de calidad desde el primer día.

## Enfermería a domicilio en Málaga: atención sanitaria profesional en tu hogar

Nuestro equipo de enfermeros y cuidadores a domicilio está listo para brindarle atención
personalizada, adaptándose a su entorno habitual, ofreciendo cuidados sanitarios profesionales con
cercanía y experiencia.
* Apoyo sanitario en pacientes dependientes o encamados
* Supervisión del uso de camas, grúas y ayudas técnicas
* Atención vinculada a procesos de recuperación
Este servicio refuerza nuestra propuesta integral, uniendo alquiler sanitario con atención
profesional, algo clave para la tranquilidad de las familias.
[ Solicitar enfermería ][32]
Confianza y Garantía

## Ipsomedical: experiencia, certificaciones y alianzas que generan confianza

En Ipsomedical contamos con una sólida trayectoria profesional y hemos firmado acuerdos con
proveedores nacionales reconocidos, aseguradoras y entidades sanitarias que avalan nuestro trabajo.

## Alianza estratégica con FORTA

Colaboración con uno de los principales proveedores de equipamiento sanitario a nivel nacional.

## Autorización para ofrecer seguros de Mapfre a los clientes de Ipsomedical

Ipsomedical ha llegado a un acuerdo con Mapfre para ofrecer todos los seguros a sus clientes con
asesoramiento personal y profesional. (Salud, vida, mascotas y hogar).

## Certificaciones oficiales y formación continua de nuestro equipo sanitario

Equipo profesional con certificaciones oficiales y formación continua en el sector sanitario.
Todo ello garantiza un servicio seguro, homologado y conforme a los estándares exigidos por las
principales aseguradoras del país.

Got questions?

## Explore our FAQ section to learn more.

### Is Simplify free? How do you make money?

We dropped out of college and started Simplify to equip job seekers with the tools they need to put
their best foot forward in the job search. The base version of Simplify and Simplify Copilot –
including unlimited job tracking and autofill – is and will be free forever. We make money by
charging companies to post jobs and promote their openings – we don't sell your data. We also have a
premium subscription called Simplify+ that offers an additional suite of AI features to help you
supercharge your job search.

### How does Simplify work?

Think of Simplify like a personal assistant for your career. When you create a profile, you'll tell
us the skills you have, the types jobs you're looking for, and any dealbreakers (minimum salary,
location, visa sponsorship, etc.). Our AI agent will find you the specific opportunities that fit
you from the millions of positions in our database. When you apply, we'll help you autofill your
application and show you the most important keywords that are missing from your resume. We also have
an AI resume builder that lets you tailor and optimize your resume in seconds. Finally, our tracker
helps you stay organized across all the jobs you've applied to. Ready to see Simplify in action?
Click the teal "Sign-Up" button to get started!

### How does Simplify handle my data?

We're internet users too and place a heavy emphasis and commitment to your privacy. First and

## Explore our FAQ section to learn more.

### Is Simplify free? How do you make money?

We dropped out of college and started Simplify to equip job seekers with the tools they need to put
their best foot forward in the job search. The base version of Simplify and Simplify Copilot –
including unlimited job tracking and autofill – is and will be free forever. We make money by
charging companies to post jobs and promote their openings – we don't sell your data. We also have a
premium subscription called Simplify+ that offers an additional suite of AI features to help you
supercharge your job search.

### How does Simplify work?

Think of Simplify like a personal assistant for your career. When you create a profile, you'll tell
us the skills you have, the types jobs you're looking for, and any dealbreakers (minimum salary,
location, visa sponsorship, etc.). Our AI agent will find you the specific opportunities that fit
you from the millions of positions in our database. When you apply, we'll help you autofill your
application and show you the most important keywords that are missing from your resume. We also have
an AI resume builder that lets you tailor and optimize your resume in seconds. Finally, our tracker
helps you stay organized across all the jobs you've applied to. Ready to see Simplify in action?
Click the teal "Sign-Up" button to get started!

1. What nursing services do you provide in Gurgaon? +
Situ Home Care Service provides professional nursing services in Gurgaon including post-operative
care, elderly care, ICU care at home, injection services, wound dressing, medication management,
patient monitoring, bedridden patient care, and chronic disease management. Our experienced nursing
staff delivers quality healthcare in the comfort of your home.
2. Are your nurses professionally trained and verified? +
Yes. Our nursing professionals are experienced, trained, and carefully verified before being
assigned to patients. We focus on providing safe, compassionate, and reliable healthcare services
for every patient.
3. Do you provide 24/7 nursing services in Gurgaon? +
Yes. We offer flexible nursing services including 12-hour, overnight, and 24-hour nursing support
depending on the patient's medical condition and care requirements.
4. Can I hire a nurse after hospital discharge? +
Absolutely. Our post-hospitalization nursing care helps patients recover safely at home through
medication support, wound care, vital monitoring, mobility assistance, and regular health
assessments.
5. Do you provide nursing care for elderly patients? +
Yes. Our elderly nursing services include personal hygiene assistance, medication reminders,
mobility support, vital monitoring, chronic disease management, companionship, and overall
healthcare supervision at home.
6. Which areas of Gurgaon do you serve? +

Course Road, Sector 14, Sector 22, Sector 31, Sector 46, Sector 47, Sector 56, Sushant Lok, South
City, and nearby locations.
7. How quickly can nursing services be arranged? +
Depending on availability and patient requirements, we strive to arrange nursing services as quickly
as possible. Contact our team for immediate assistance and care planning.
8. Can I book nursing services for short-term or long-term care? +
Yes. We offer both short-term nursing services for recovery after surgery as well as long-term
nursing support for elderly, bedridden, and chronic care patients.
9. Do you provide home ICU nursing support? +
Yes. We provide skilled nursing support for patients requiring ICU-level care at home, including
monitoring, ventilator assistance, oxygen support, medication administration, and coordination with
doctors as required.
10. How can I contact Situ Home Care Service for nursing services? +
You can call us anytime to discuss your healthcare needs and book professional nursing services in
Gurgaon.

Syntron Electromechanical Feeders
Syntron Material Handling
Syntron® MF heavy-duty electromechanical feeders are the heavyweights of bulk material handling,
used for higher-capacity requirements. The eight heavy-duty models handle capacities from 100 to
4,000 tons per hour.*

Syntron heavy-duty electromechanical feeders combine extra structural strength with durable
components. The deep wing plates form a bridge between the inlet and discharge suspension supports,
providing extra strength for years of dependable service. Standard troughs feature unitized
weldments—one-piece, completely welded units for greater strength. Troughs are also available with
bolt-together construction for tunnel installations or other confined areas. MF heavy-duty
electromechanical feeders are two-mass, spring-connected, and sub-resonant-tuned. The exciter unit
is connected to the trough via corrosion-resistant polymeric drive springs, which reduce vertical
stroke while amplifying stroke in the direction of material flow. This feature creates straight line
motion, providing maximum material flow rate and feeder capacity. Syntron feeders also utilize
custom-engineered electromechanical vibrators. These vibrators feature an L10 life expectancy of
over 100,000 hours in normal operation, and they allow quick removal via access from both sides of
the feeder or from the bottom. Attachments for safety cables are included on all Syntron feeders.

*Based on dry sand weighing 100 pounds per cubic foot. Capacities vary depending on material
characteristics, material density, trough length and width, trough liner type, feeder installation,
skirt boards, and hopper transitions.

Syntron Material Handling
The SyntroFlo cone crusher loading feeder by Syntron is a MF two-mass tuned direct drive vibratory
feeder with an engineered discharge uniquely designed for equal distribution of product. The trough
including the discharge is fully lined to account for wear. Like traditionally designed feeders, it
is suspension mounted, which can be easily integrated into a trolley system allowing it to be moved
out of the way for crusher maintenance. In side-by-side installations of a feeder-plus-rotary
distributor versus a SyntroFlo cone crusher loading feeder directly feeding the crusher, the
SyntroFlo unit delivered superior, cone-friendly performance. The uniform distribution provided by
the SyntroFlo unit increased curser manganese life and yielded more cubicle-formed product.

SyntroFlo is available in three standard sizes for tertiary crusher applications: STF-3F, STF-4F,
and STF-5F. In addition, we are developing the STF-3C, STF-4C, and STF-5C for secondary crushing
applications. Both designs work with 300 HP, 400 HP, and 500 HP cones, respectively. These designs
will allow the SyntroFlo unit to be a cost-effective solution for feeding your cone crusher
equipment. We can build a custom cone crushing feeder unit for larger and smaller applications upon

on conditions that affect mobility, balance, and physical recovery. At Sleep Junkie, she is

community. Her philanthropic work at the H.O.P.E Clinic further demonstrates her commitment to her

#### About Shawna Robins

Shawna Robins is a National Board-Certified Health and Wellness Coach (NBHWC), graduate of the
Institute of Integrative Nutrition (IIN), and #1 Amazon bestselling author. She holds a BA in
Journalism from the University of Washington and specializes in functional nutrition, hormone
health, and sleep optimization. She is the founder and CEO of Kaia Health and Wellness and the
author of Powerful Sleep and Irresistibly Healthy. At Sleep Junkie, she is available to review
content related to wellness, nutrition, and hormone…

As an innovative leader in her field, Shawna has authored two best-selling books and has spoken for
renowned organizations such as Lumen Technologies, Zayo, and the Women in Tech Conference. She sits
on the Advisory Board of JourneyWoman, a global community of over 65,000 female solo travelers aged
50 and above.

Shawna’s expertise has been featured in various media outlets, including Thrive Global, Medium,
Huffington Post, Authority Magazine, Sleep Junkie, Sweat Life, and Dr. Mindy Pelz’s podcast. Her
best-selling book, Powerful Sleep – Rest Deeply, Repair Your Brain and Restore Your Life, received
an International Impact Book Award in 2022.

Mentorship and collaboration are integral aspects of Shawna’s career. She works closely with other
coaches, offering support and feedback, and has developed a sleep and menopause program to assist
women who feel unheard by their doctors. Through JourneyWoman, Shawna leads women-only wellness
adventure retreats around the world, with upcoming events in Morocco and Fiji.

Shawna’s commitment to staying current with the latest developments and research in her field is
evident in her journalistic background and her plans to write a third book. Her client-centered
approach to coaching focuses on providing a safe, non-judgmental environment where clients can
explore the changes they need to make in their lives.

To create sustainable change, Shawna utilizes the “Circle of Life” coaching tool to help clients
evaluate various aspects of their well-being. She teaches clients the importance of nourishing their
bodies with both primary (the food they eat) and secondary (their lifestyle) food sources.

Shawna is actively involved in professional communities such as the NBHWC, JourneyWoman Advisory
Board, IIN alumni, UW alumni groups, and a local charity called Women For Good. To support
Alzheimer’s and Brain Health Awareness Month, Shawna donates all proceeds from her book, Powerful
Sleep, to the Alzheimer’s Association during the month of June.

As a writer, travel enthusiast, functional nutritionist, hormone health specialist, sleep expert,
bestselling author, mother of three, and cancer survivor, Shawna embraces life’s journey in three
“sparks.” Now entering her Third Spark, she believes in self-love, transformation, and embracing
health challenges to thrive during this magical time in life. Through her work at Kaia Health and
Wellness, Shawna empowers clients to navigate their own health journeys and live their best lives.

Shawna Robins is a National Board-Certified Health and Wellness Coach (NBHWC), graduate of the

  using advanced laser cutting equipment, ensuring consistent dimensional accuracy across all
  product lines.
* 🤖 **Robotic Welding Process:** Our automated robotic welding systems deliver uniform,
  high-strength structural welds — eliminating human error and guaranteeing structural integrity for
  every bed frame and furniture piece.
* 🎨 **Strict Spray Coating Control:** Surface treatments and powder coatings are applied under
  tightly controlled conditions to ensure corrosion resistance, smooth finish, and long-term
  durability.
* 📦 **Packaging & Assembly Inspection:** Each unit is assembled correctly, functionally tested, and
  inspected before packaging — with packaging materials verified for transit protection.
* 🔬 **Multi-Function Testing:** All electrical, mechanical, and load-bearing functions are tested
  against international standards before shipment approval.

[What Is the Pressure Redistribution Capability of Silicone Mattresses?]
What Is the Pressure Redistribution Capability of Silicone Mattresses?

Pressure redistribution is one of the most critical functions of any medical mattress, especially in
intensive care units (ICUs), long-term care facilities, and wards with high-risk or immobile
patients. Silicone mattresses have gained wide recognition in the medical field because of their
exceptional pressure redistribution capability, helping reduce the risk of pressure injuries, skin
breakdown, and discomfort during long periods of hospitalization.

View Details

[How Do You Clean and Disinfect a Silicone Hospital Mattress?]
How Do You Clean and Disinfect a Silicone Hospital Mattress?

Keeping a silicone hospital mattress clean and properly disinfected is essential for protecting
patients from healthcare-associated infections (HAIs), cross-contamination, and skin complications
such as pressure ulcers.

What Is the Pressure Redistribution Capability of Silicone Mattresses?

Pressure redistribution is one of the most critical functions of any medical mattress, especially in
intensive care units (ICUs), long-term care facilities, and wards with high-risk or immobile
patients. Silicone mattresses have gained wide recognition in the medical field because of their
exceptional pressure redistribution capability, helping reduce the risk of pressure injuries, skin
breakdown, and discomfort during long periods of hospitalization.
